title: codeadd result v1
description: The structured result of one codeadd command run. Every key is always present; use null for unknown, never omit a key and never invent a value. needs_approval is true exactly when status is needs-approval. reason is non-null and non-empty when status is not done; on done it is null unless the run has a caveat worth one line.

v.description: Schema version. Starts at 1. A breaking change bumps it.

status.description: The outcome. done: the command finished its work. stopped: a gate or a hard stop ended the run on purpose. needs-approval: the run is waiting on the user. failed: an error the command did not plan for.

stage.description: The command name, for example add-framework--build. Never empty.

branch.description: The current branch, or null when unknown.

commits.description: Short SHAs this run created, in order. An empty array when none.

tests.description: Test counts before and after the run, or null when no test run happened. Each side is null when that run did not happen.

before.description: Counts from the run before the change, or null.

after.description: Counts from the run after the change, or null.

pr.description: The pull request this run opened or updated, or null.

ci.description: The required-checks state on the head SHA, when the command read it; null when it did not.

ticket.description: The last board write this run made, or null when it made none.

status.description: The status the ticket was written to.

sha.description: The commit SHA of the write, or null when the write degraded.

pushed.description: True when the write reached main; false when it degraded.

next_step.description: The Continuation Line verbatim, or null when the command prints none.

needs_approval.description: True when the run is waiting on the user.

reason.description: The gate, stop or question, in one line; null when there is none.
